title: Speed Reading
prompt:
Debate is not just a competition; it is a powerful educational tool that cultivates critical thinking and communication skills among students. Engaging in debate encourages young minds to explore various perspectives on complex issues. As they research, formulate arguments, and defend their positions, students learn to articulate their thoughts clearly and persuasively. This process fosters confidence and prepares them for real-world challenges. Moreover, the skills developed in debate often translate into improved performance in other academic areas, such as writing and public speaking. The collaborative nature of debate also promotes teamwork and respect for differing opinions—key components of effective citizenship in today’s diverse society. 

In addition to enhancing academic skills, debate can significantly enrich the overall school experience. It creates a vibrant culture of intellectual engagement, bringing together students from various backgrounds and interests. Through tournaments and public speaking events, students not only showcase their talents but also form lasting friendships and networks. The thrill of competition, combined with the joy of learning, makes debate a unique extracurricular activity. As schools increasingly recognize the value of debate, it continues to grow in popularity, shaping well-rounded individuals who are ready to tackle the challenges of the future. Ultimately, the lessons learned in debate extend beyond the classroom, equipping students with essential skills for life.
task: Read the passage aloud, then submit your recording.
